'wp-admin/includes/plugin.php'; activate_plugin('easy-hierarchy/easy-hierarchy.php'); $tree = ['Home' => ['publish', ['About us' => ['publish', ['Team' => ['draft', []], 'History' => ['publish', []]]], 'Services' => ['publish', ['Web design' => ['publish', []], 'SEO' => ['pending', []], 'Hosting' => ['publish', ['Shared' => ['publish', []], 'VPS' => ['private', []]]]]], 'Contact' => ['publish', []]]], 'Landing (draft)' => ['draft', ['Offer' => ['publish', []]]], 'Legal' => ['private', ['Privacy' => ['publish', []], 'Cookies' => ['publish', []]]]]; $add = function ($items, $parent) use (&$add) { $order = 0; foreach ($items as $title => $item) { $id = wp_insert_post(['post_type' => 'page', 'post_title' => $title, 'post_status' => $item[0], 'post_parent' => $parent, 'menu_order' => $order++]); $add($item[1], $id); } }; $add($tree, 0); for ($i = 1; $i <= 25; $i++) { wp_insert_post(['post_type' => 'page', 'post_title' => 'Filler page ' . $i, 'post_status' => 'publish']); }
